gap.title: Table 1a: the 4-by-4 bipartite graph with mask 5805 has an AND/OR circuit of fan-in at most two, at most 10 gates, representing it, none of at most 9
gap.statement:
PEqualNP.Represents.RepSizeAtMost (fun u v : Fin 4 => (5805 : ℕ).testBit (4 * u.val + v.val)) 10 ∧
  ¬ PEqualNP.Represents.RepSizeAtMost (fun u v : Fin 4 => (5805 : ℕ).testBit (4 * u.val + v.val)) 9
gap.unlocks: one entry of Table 1a: the exact cost of representing a small bipartite graph, the measure in which the bridge to general circuits is stated
gap.context: SKETCH: two halves. Upper: exhibit an AND/OR circuit with the stated number of gates and check the 16 inputs with one vertex on each side; a finite check. Lower: no circuit with one gate fewer represents the graph: a finite search settled by an unsatisfiability certificate that the kernel replays through the promise link on the public tree (Promise.rep_lower44). The value was computed in house by ONE method only and is not checked: it may be wrong, and its opposite row is being offered beside it. No sorry, no new axiom. Own namespace for every declaration.
